bd-serinus-canaria.title: Canary
bd-serinus-canaria.summary: A small finch bred for centuries for its song, color or shape, with more than 200 breeds. Males are the singers. Canaries are territorial and should each have a cage of their own.
rows: Usually about 5–6 in (13–15 cm) and 15–20 g; some breeds range from 4 to 9 in
Can live more than 14 years with proper care
One canary per cage; canaries are territorial, and housing them together can end badly
Birdseed alone is not enough: base the diet on canary pellets
Primarily solitary and territorial; keep one canary per cage
Males sing; hens can sing a little, less well and less often
Domestic form of the wild canary of the Macaronesian islands (Canary Islands and nearby)
